scientific_integrity: The theorem follows from exact Gaussian regression, circle geometry, and Laplace asymptotics. Finite numerical checks do not replace the analytical proof. Nonreal sRR behavior itself is acknowledged in the originating 2021 work; only the quantified law and prefactor are assessed as new.
scientific_limitations: Exact three-dimensional symmetric positive-definite nonterminal two-step Lanczos family with real iid Gaussian sketches. Full higher-dimensional sketched Ritz statistics, structured sketches, postprocessed Ritz accuracy, and finite-precision effects remain unproved.
title: Sharp Gaussian-sketch probabilities for nonreal Ritz pairs in a positive-definite Lanczos triple
